is an ISS live earth view happening right now from space at the International Space Station. Due to the Station's orbit, it appears to travel from west to east over our planet, and due to Earth's own rotation, the Space Station moves 2200 km to the west on each orbit. Any lightning that strikes the ground will appear on this map in real-time.  This is useful for seeing if the ISS will be passing over any lightning storms while on the night side of earth.\n\n2.
